title: What may delete an idle note's files from the laptop, and when?
summary: After 30 days with no edit, once every page is in the cloud, a note's files may leave the laptop; opening it again downloads it back.

children.prompt: What removes an idle note's files from a laptop?

options.label: New code that scans every note at each start
Per note, from that note's own record

children.prompt: Which storage may remove a note's files after 30 days?

options.label: Only storage whose keys cannot delete

children.prompt: What should a share link from before the rebuild open?

options.label: The old note, read-only
options.hint: The old web page stays for these links until the cleanup release
